general.name: Docker - Update Expected Containers [Lin]
general.description: Shows or changes this host's Docker expected-containers list, ignore patterns and review state; changes no container. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrAction
variables.description: Show the lists and review state; confirm the list is reviewed (enables container and image cleanup); accept what exists now; add/remove entries or ignore patterns.

variables.name: usrItems
variables.description: Add/Remove: container names, name:<name> or compose:<project>/<service>, space or comma separated. Ignore actions: regexes, space separated. Confirm reviewed: an optional note.
